Built for Business-Grade AI

Compact, secure, and lightning-fast AI — fine-tuned for your industry, enriched by your knowledge bases.

Trained on industry-specific data

Our SLMs are custom-trained on domain-specific datasets from finance and healthcare to telecom delivering precise, jargon-aware responses.

Lightweight models, blazing-fast performance

Get LLM-grade outcomes with a fraction of the size. Our SLMs are optimized to run on-device or in low-latency environments.

Proprietary models hosted where you want

Deploy our models within your own secure infrastructure. No data leaves your environment- ensuring full compliance and control.

RAG-powered, context-rich responses

Integrate external knowledge bases via RAG to give your agents live, real-world awareness- from policy documents to product catalogs.

Speech Recognition:

Powered by Barge-in Intelligence

Handle real-time interruptions, recognize speech accurately mid-call, and automate more with our advanced barge-in ASR across 40+ languages.

Recognizes mid-sentence without waiting for silence

Maintains high accuracy even with overlapping voices

Enables real-time responses without delays

Enables up to 70% better accuracy

Fails when customer interrupts IVR or speaks early

Misses context due to delayed recognition

Creates dead-air and poor experience during escalation

Blocks automation, leading to more manual handoffs

Multilingual Customer Conversations

Effortlessly handle conversations where customers switch between languages mid-sentence, no confusion, just smooth automation.

Boosts CX in Multilingual Markets:

Customers often switch from Hindi to English or Tamil to English mid-call. Our AI handles this naturally, reducing friction.

Prevents Call Drop-offs

Without dynamic switching, bots fail to understand, leading to manual escalation or abandoned calls.

Reduces Call Duration by Up to 25%

Eliminates the need for language confirmation loops or restarts, speeding up resolution.
